[[Speak With Headmaster Kaa (Mesmer)]] | followed by = [[Cleansing the Shrine]] | profession = Mesmer | primary = y | secondary = n }} Canthans interested in mesmering can find their first actual instructor with this quest. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Mesmer | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Search Sunqua Vale for Mei Ling. ===Early benefits=== * You receive the following skills after accepting this quest: ** {{skill icon|Conjure Phantasm}} ** {{skill icon|Empathy}} ** {{skill icon|Ether Feast}} ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Mei Ling can be found at the center of Sunqua Vale, standing at the closest ramp towards the snowy mountains from Shing Jea Monastery. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Kaa ''[[Mei Ling]] is my assistant and will begin teaching you the way of the Mesmer. She should be in [[Sunqua Vale]] awaiting new students. Open your mind to the power.'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I will look for Mei Ling. | decline = I'm not ready yet. | ask = You are a student of mine, yes? Did [[Mei Ling]] send you back here, or have you not found her yet? She is waiting in [[Sunqua Vale]]. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Mei Ling ''Headmaster Kaa sent you to me, did he not? You would be wise to heed him, no matter what others might say. I will continue your training now.''
